description: Binding, model, and effort policy for this repository's agent workflows. scripts/agent-policy.mjs reads this file and generates both the Claude Code and Codex definitions from it.

issue-creation.summary: Plan, draft, classify, and publish issues in the main thread

issue-triage.summary: Independent read-only classification, decomposition, and dependency judgment of drafted issues, when filing needs it

implementation.summary: Delegated leaf delivery and PR rework through ready-for-review PRs; binding for the implementer, advisory only for explicit inline delivery

code-review.summary: Read-only review against acceptance criteria and exact SHAs

claude.description: Model aliases accepted by the Agent tool and subagent frontmatter, with the effort levels each supports. Full IDs matching modelIdPattern are accepted with the same effort levels.

codex.description: Model slugs accepted by spawn_agent, with the reasoning efforts each supports. Keep this in step with the Codex model catalog (`codex debug models`).

implementationEffort.description: Medium-first rubric for implementer effort. scripts/delivery-queue.mjs reads recorded decisions against it; only a rule whose required evidence is all recorded selects high, and labels, Size, and file count never do.

H1-boundary.description: Design or prove a new security, immutable-evidence, persistent-data, or compatibility guarantee across components whose mechanism the issue or spec leaves unresolved. Applying an established, specified pattern does not qualify.

H2-coupled-design.description: An algorithm, state machine, concurrency protocol, or migration has interacting correctness constraints the supplied design does not resolve, and existing patterns, focused tests, or a reviewable decomposition do not resolve them. File count, Size, and multiple consumers do not qualify.

H3-demonstrated-limit.description: A medium attempt produced a reproducible correctness failure or a substantive review finding that requires revising the underlying design. Routine test, formatting, or environment failures, a first unsuccessful attempt, and the number of review rounds do not qualify.
